powers.title: Adaptable Flanker
powers.description: The mere presence of an ally gives you all the advantage you need.
rows: Requirement: You and an ally must be adjacent to the same enemy.
Effect: You gain combat advantage against the enemy until the start of your next turn.

powers.title: Agile Footwork
powers.description: Though your foe wants to move in closely, you'd rather keep your distance, so you nimbly move away.
rows: Trigger: An enemy ends its turn adjacent to you.
Effect: You shift up to 3 squares.
powers.source: Published in Dragon Magazine 381, page(s) 69, Heroes of the Fallen Lands, page(s) 180.

powers.title: Arm and Edge
powers.description: You sharpen your aim and flex your arm, preparing to hurl your dagger at a distant foe.
rows: Effect: Until the stance ends, whenever you make a ranged attack with a thrown weapon or a sling, you double the normal range and the long range.

powers.title: Cunning Step
powers.description: You cut corners and dodge obstacles, making it seem as though you move with unnatural speed.
rows: Effect: Until the stance ends, you gain a power bonus to speed equal to half your Intelligence.

powers.title: Deadly Knowledge
powers.description: You twist your weapon or adjust your aim, hurting your foe a little more than usual.
rows: Trigger: Your attack bloodies an enemy or scores a critical hit against an enemy
Effect: The triggering attack deals extra damage equal to your Intelligence to the enemy.

powers.title: Double Take
powers.description: Suspecting something is hidden, you concentrate your will on spotting it.
rows: Prerequisite: You must be proficient in Perception.
Effect: Make a Perception check with a bonus equal to your Charisma.

powers.title: Fleeting Ghost
powers.description: You are stealthy and fleet of foot at the same time.
rows: Prerequisite: You must be proficient in Stealth.
Effect: You move up to your speed and can make a Stealth check to hide. You take no penalty to the Stealth check for the movement, though you must still meet the normal requirements to hide.
powers.source: Published in Player's Handbook, page(s) 119, Heroes of the Fallen Lands, page(s) 180, Class Compendium.

powers.title: Great Leap
powers.description: You leap a great distance without a running start.
rows: Prerequisite: You must be proficient in Athletics.
Effect: You make an Athletics check to jump. You are considered to have a running start, and the distance of the jump isn't limited by your speed.
powers.source: Published in Player's Handbook, page(s) 119, Class Compendium.

powers.title: Hop up
powers.description: Rolling with a blow that knocked you down, you hop up just a few steps away.
rows: Trigger: You are knocked prone
Prerequisite: You must be proficient in Acrobatics.
Effect: You stand up and can shift 1 square.

powers.title: Lurker's Cloak
powers.description: You maximize the benefit of the obstacle or shadows hiding you.
rows: Effect: Until the end of your next turn, you gain a +2 power bonus to all defenses while you have any concealment or any cover.

powers.title: Marked Escape
powers.description: Through your subtlety, you end your enemy's mark.
rows: Requirement: You must be marked.
Effect: The marked condition ends on you.

powers.title: Master of Deceit
powers.description: The line between truth and deception is thin, and you cross it with ease.
rows: Prerequisite: You must be proficient in Bluff.
Trigger: You make a Bluff check and dislike the result.
Effect: You reroll the Bluff check and must use the second result.
powers.source: Published in Player's Handbook, page(s) 119, Class Compendium.

powers.title: Quick Fingers
powers.description: You can pilfer a coin pouch in the blink of an eye.
rows: Prerequisite: You must be proficient in Thievery.
Effect: You make a Thievery check as part of this action, even if the check is normally a standard action.
powers.source: Published in Player's Handbook, page(s) 119, Class Compendium.

powers.title: Reap the Rattled
powers.description: Rattled foes are ripe fodder for your attacks.
rows: Prerequisite: You must be proficient in Intimidate.
Effect: Select an enemy within line of sight that is taking the penalty from one of your rattling attacks. You gain combat advantage against that enemy until the end of your next turn.

powers.title: Sneak in the Attack
powers.description: You give your ally the advantage she needs to inflict a devastating attack.
rows: Target: One creature
Effect: Until the start of your next turn, the next ally who hits the target and has combat advantage against it deals extra damage against it equal to your Sneak Attack damage.

powers.title: Sudden Leap
powers.description: You jump from a standing position, surprising your foes.
rows: Prerequisite: You must be proficient in Athletics.
Effect: You jump a number of squares up to half your speed.
powers.source: Published in Heroes of the Fallen Lands, page(s) 180.

powers.title: Switcheroo
powers.description: You pull the old switcheroo to put your enemies off guard.
rows: Target: You and one ally in the burst
Effect: The targets swap places.

powers.title: Tumble
powers.description: You dodge and tumble past your foes with such speed and precision that they are unable to react.
rows: Prerequisite: You must be proficient in Acrobatics.
Effect: You shift up to your speed.
powers.source: Published in Player's Handbook, page(s) 119, Heroes of the Fallen Lands, page(s) 181, Class Compendium.

powers.title: Blind Spot Advantage
powers.description: You take advantage of your enemy's blind spot to ensure that you won't be hit.
rows: Effect: You gain concealment against one enemy you can see until the end of your next turn.

powers.title: Chameleon
powers.description: You blend into your surroundings.
rows: Prerequisite: You must be proficient in Stealth.
Trigger: You are hidden and lose cover or concealment against an enemy.

Effect: You make a Stealth check. If your check beats the triggering enemy's passive Perception, you remain hidden from it, and until the end of your next turn you can remain hidden from it without needing any cover or concealment.
powers.source: Published in Player's Handbook, page(s) 120, Class Compendium.

powers.title: Ferret Out Frailty
powers.description: You can always spot easy prey.
rows: Prerequisite: You must be proficient in Insight.

Effect: Until the beginning of your next turn, you gain combat advantage against one target within line of sight. If the target is taking the attack penalty from one of your rattling attacks, you instead gain combat advantage until the end of your next turn.

powers.title: Fortuitous Dodge
powers.description: You duck out of the way of an incoming attack, and it strikes another target.
rows: Trigger: A melee or a ranged attack misses you
Target: One creature other than the attacker
Effect: The target is also targeted by the triggering attack. You can then shift 1 square.

powers.title: Hidden Blade
powers.description: You conceal a small weapon until it's time to strike.
rows: Prerequisite: You must be proficient in Thievery.
Effect: You gain combat advantage for the next attack you make with an off-hand weapon before the end of your turn.
powers.source: Published in PH Heroes: Series 1, Heroes of the Fallen Lands, page(s) 182.

powers.title: Ignoble Escape
powers.description: With nimble ease, you sidestep one perilous situation after another, ignoring any who challenge you.
rows: Prerequisite: You must be proficient in Acrobatics.
Effect: If you are marked, that condition ends on you. You can shift up to your speed.
powers.source: Published in Player's Handbook, page(s) 120, Class Compendium.

powers.title: Mob Mentality
powers.description: When it comes to lying, cajoling, or persuading others, your allies follow your lead.
rows: Prerequisite: You must be proficient in Intimidate.
Targets: You and each ally in the burst
Effect: Each target gains a +2 power bonus to Charisma-based skill checks and ability checks until the end of your next turn.
powers.source: Published in Player's Handbook, page(s) 120, Class Compendium.

powers.title: Nimble Climb
powers.description: You climb surfaces with astounding ease.
rows: Prerequisite: You must be proficient in Athletics.
Effect: You make an Athletics check to climb. If the check succeeds, you gain a +4 power bonus to your speed while climbing during this move.
powers.source: Published in Player's Handbook, page(s) 120, Heroes of the Fallen Lands, page(s) 182, Class Compendium.

powers.title: Perfect Feint
powers.description: Your feint takes everyone by surprise.
rows: Prerequisite: You must be proficient in Bluff.
Target: Each enemy in the burst you can see
Effect: Each target grants combat advantage to you until the end of your next turn.

powers.title: Sidestep Stance
powers.description: You go on the defensive against a particular opponent, watching carefully for its attacks.
rows: Prerequisite: You must be proficient in Acrobatics.

Effect: Choose one enemy within 5 squares of you that you can see. Until the stance ends, you gain a +2 power bonus to AC against that enemy's melee attacks and ranged attacks if you can see the enemy. You can choose a new enemy as a minor action.

powers.title: Slip Aside
powers.description: You distract a foe to diminish the effect of an attack.
rows: Prerequisite: You must be proficient in Stealth.
Trigger: You are hit by an attack against your AC or Reflex.
Effect: You take only half damage from the triggering attack.
powers.source: Published in Heroes of the Fallen Lands, page(s) 183.

powers.title: Slippery Mind
powers.description: You cloud your mind with vague thoughts that shield you against a sudden mental attack.
rows: Prerequisite: You must be proficient in Bluff.
Trigger: You are hit by an attack against your Will.
Effect: Gain a +2 power bonus to Will against the triggering attack.
powers.source: Published in Player's Handbook, page(s) 121, Class Compendium.

powers.title: Swift Parry
powers.description: You deflect your enemy's attack, causing the force behind its blow to send it off balance and leaving it vulnerable to your next attack.
rows: Requirement: You must be wielding a light blade.
Trigger: You are hit by a melee attack
Effect: You gain a bonus to defenses against the triggering attack equal to your Charisma, and you gain combat advantage against the attacker until the end of your next turn.
powers.source: Published in Dragon Magazine 381, page(s) 69, Heroes of the Fallen Lands, page(s) 183.

powers.title: Threatening Glare
powers.description: Your hostile visage warns enemies to beware your wrath.
rows: Prerequisite: You must be proficient in Intimidate.

Effect: Until the end of your turn, opportunity attacks against you deal half damage, and if an enemy makes an opportunity attack against you, you gain combat advantage against that enemy until the end of your next turn.

powers.title: Ugly Finish
powers.description: A bloody display of force rattles nearby enemies.
rows: Prerequisite: You must be proficient in Intimidate.
Trigger: You score a critical hit against an enemy with a melee attack or reduce an enemy to 0 hit points with a melee attack
Target: Each enemy in the burst
Effect: Each target takes a –2 penalty to attack rolls and grants combat advantage until the end of your next turn.

powers.title: Vault Position
powers.description: You assume a balanced pose, ready to leap away from danger at a moment's notice.
rows: Prerequisite: You must be proficient in Acrobatics and Athletics.
Effect: Until the stance ends, you gain a +1 power bonus to Reflex. As a minor action, you can make an Athletics check to jump, but doing so ends the stance.

powers.title: Vexing Flanker
powers.description: Nimble feet and intense focus keep you on your foe.
rows: Trigger: An ally enters a square adjacent to an enemy adjacent to you
Effect: You can shift to any other square adjacent to the enemy.

powers.title: Acrobat's Escape
powers.description: As an enemy tries to move close, you slip away and leave the approaching foe off balance.
rows: Prerequisite: You must be proficient in Acrobatics.
Trigger: An enemy enters a square adjacent to you.
Target: The triggering enemy
Effect: The target is immobilized until the start of its next turn. You then shift a number of squares up to your Dexterity to a square that is not adjacent to the target.
powers.source: Published in Heroes of the Fallen Lands, page(s) 184.

powers.title: Brisk Stride
powers.description: Leaping across minor obstacles, you dart across the battlefield.
rows: Prerequisite: You must be proficient in Athletics.
Effect: You can move your speed + 4. During this movement and until the end of your next turn, you can move across difficult terrain at your normal speed.

powers.title: Certain Freedom
powers.description: You are as slippery as an eel.
rows: Prerequisite: You must be proficient in Acrobatics.
Effect: You automatically succeed on an Acrobatics check to escape from a grab or from restraints.
powers.source: Published in Player's Handbook, page(s) 121, Class Compendium.

powers.title: Close Quarters
powers.description: You take cover beneath a much larger creature, making it harder for the creature to hit you.
rows: Prerequisite: You must be proficient in Acrobatics.

Effect: You move 1 square into the target's space, provoking opportunity attacks as normal. While there, you have combat advantage against it, and it takes a -4 penalty to attack rolls against you. When the target moves, you move with it, staying in the same portion of its space. The target can take a standard action to make a Strength or a Dexterity vs. Reflex attack against you, without the -4 penalty. On a hit, the target slides you 1 square into an adjacent square, and this effect ends.
powers.source: Published in Player's Handbook, page(s) 122, Class Compendium.

powers.title: Combat Tumbleset
powers.description: You deftly somersault into position.
rows: Prerequisite: You must be proficient in Acrobatics.
Effect: You can shift your speed and can shift through squares occupied by enemies during this movement.

powers.title: Counter-Step
powers.description: As your foe bears down on you, you use its momentum to maneuver it into position for your counterattack.
rows: Prerequisite: You must be proficient in Athletics.
Trigger: An enemy enters a square adjacent to you.
Target: The triggering enemy

Effect: You can slide the target 1 square. You then shift up to 2 squares to a square adjacent to the target. You gain combat advantage and a +2 power bonus to all defenses against the target until the end of your next turn.
powers.source: Published in Heroes of the Fallen Lands, page(s) 184.

powers.title: Dangerous Theft
powers.description: You boldly snatch an item from an enemy.
rows: Prerequisite: You must be proficient in Thievery.
Effect: On your next action, ignore the -10 penalty when you make a Thievery check to pick a pocket during combat.
powers.source: Published in Player's Handbook, page(s) 122, Class Compendium.

powers.title: Daring Gamble
powers.description: Putting yourself at risk gives you the opening you need to bring this battle to its close.
rows: Effect: Until the start of your next turn, any enemy that attacks you grants combat advantage to you until the end of the encounter.

powers.title: Deadly Sacrifice
powers.description: Your threat draws your enemy's attack. If you survive, you can be certain the foe will pay.
rows: Trigger: An ally adjacent to you is hit by an enemy's melee attack
Target: The triggering ally

Effect: You and the target swap places. The attack hits you instead of the target. The enemy grants combat advantage to you until the end of the encounter. In addition, your Sneak Attack deals extra damage against the enemy equal to your Intelligence until the end of the encounter.

powers.title: Executioner's Mien
powers.description: Every one of your attacks exudes a murderous intent that unnerves your adversaries.
rows: Prerequisite: You must be proficient in Intimidate.
Effect: Until the stance ends, all your attacks gain the rattling keyword.

powers.title: Gap in the Armor
powers.description: You take a moment to find a weak point in your opponent's defenses.
rows: Prerequisite: You must be proficient in Perception.
Effect: Choose an enemy within 5 squares of you. You gain a +2 power bonus to attack rolls against that enemy until the end of the encounter.

powers.title: Nimble Fingers
powers.description: You can snatch or stow an enemy's possessions even in the heat of combat.
rows: Prerequisite: You must be proficient in Thievery.
Target: One creature

Effect: You draw one weapon that is sheathed or worn (but not held) by the target, stow a single item on the target, or retrieve a single item the target has stowed. If you are hidden from the target, the target is not aware that you have used this power.
powers.source: Published in Heroes of the Fallen Lands, page(s) 185.

powers.title: Peripheral Concealment
powers.description: You slip away, and others briefly lose track of where you are.
rows: Prerequisite: You must be proficient in Stealth.
Requirement: No creature is within 3 squares of you.
Effect: You become hidden until you attack or until the end of your next turn.

powers.title: Shadow Stride
powers.description: You silently step from shadow to shadow, slipping past your foes unseen and unheard.
rows: Prerequisite: You must be proficient in Stealth.
Requirement: You must be hidden.

Effect: Make a Stealth check and then move up to your speed to a square where you have cover or concealment. You take no penalty to the check if you move more than 2 squares. Unless the check fails to beat an enemy's passive Perception, you remain hidden during the move, even if you have no cover or concealment during it.
powers.source: Published in Player's Handbook, page(s) 122, Heroes of the Fallen Lands, page(s) 185, Class Compendium.

powers.title: Sneaky Roll
powers.description: You take advantage of your foe's success to somersault into a better position.
rows: Prerequisite: You must be proficient in Acrobatics.
Trigger: You are hit by a melee attack.
Effect: You can shift half your speed, including through squares occupied by enemies.
